description: This file defines an interface for a test multi-collection grain in the Orleans framework. It specifies asynchronous methods for managing dictionary, list, queue, and set data structures, along with a method to retrieve the grain's activation ID.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Retrieves the activation ID of the grain.

methods.name: AddToDictionary
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the dictionary.

methods.name: RemoveFromDictionary
methods.description: Removes a key from the dictionary.

methods.name: GetDictionaryValue
methods.description: Fetches the value associated with a key in the dictionary.

methods.name: GetDictionaryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the dictionary.

methods.name: AddToList
methods.description: Adds an item to the list.

methods.name: RemoveListItemAt
methods.description: Removes an item at a specific index from the list.

methods.name: GetListItem
methods.description: Retrieves the item at a given index in the list.

methods.name: GetListCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list.

methods.name: AddToQueue
methods.description: Enqueues an item to the queue.

methods.name: DequeueItem
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at the front of the queue.

methods.name: PeekQueueItem
methods.description: Returns the item at the front of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: GetQueueCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the queue.

methods.name: AddToSet
methods.description: Adds an item to the set.

methods.name: RemoveFromSet
methods.description: Removes an item from the set.

methods.name: ContainsSetItem
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the set.

methods.name: GetSetCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the set.
